title: Loomfall key bindings
description: Schema for bindings.json — the user-editable input map consumed by the game shell (public/src/gameplay/Controls.js) and the keybinds settings UI (ux/keybinds/). Action ids are derived from Controls.js and the GAME_GUIDE controls table. Code strings are KeyboardEvent.code values (e.g. 'KeyW', 'Digit1', 'ShiftLeft', 'F3', 'Escape') plus these synthetic tokens for non-keyboard input: 'Mouse0' (left button), 'Mouse1' (middle), 'Mouse2' (right), 'Mouse3'/'Mouse4' (side buttons, MouseEvent.button numbering), 'WheelUp', 'WheelDown'. Gamepad values are Standard Gamepad mapping button indices 0-16 (https://w3c.github.io/gamepad/#remapping); analog movement (left stick) and camera (right stick) are hard-wired axes and are not rebindable here, which is why the four move* actions default gamepad to null. null means 'unbound' for that slot. Conflict rule for editors: within one device column (keyboard = primary+secondary pooled, gamepad separate) a code may be assigned to at most one action, EXCEPT the documented legacy pair sneak/sprint which the current engine drives from a single key (ShiftLeft sets both) until the builder splits them.

version.description: Format version. Consumers must reject files with a version they do not understand.

bindings.description: The active bindings. Every action id must be present (bind slots may be null).

defaults.description: Optional embedded snapshot of the factory defaults, used by the keybinds UI for per-action and reset-all restore without refetching bindings.default.json. When present it must be complete. ux/keybinds/bindings.default.json omits this block (it IS the defaults).

keyCode.description: KeyboardEvent.code string, or a synthetic Mouse0-Mouse4 / WheelUp / WheelDown token, or null for unbound.

gamepadButton.description: Standard Gamepad mapping button index (0=A/Cross ... 16=guide), or null for unbound.

moveForward.description: Walk forward. Onboarding token [MOVE] renders the four move* actions together.

jump.description: Jump / swim up. Double-tap within 300 ms triggers toggleFlight when that action is unbound.

sneak.description: Sneak (edge-safe walk). LEGACY: current Controls.js drives sneak AND sprint from ShiftLeft; the rebind layer splits them.

sprint.description: Sprint. See sneak note; ControlLeft is the forward-looking default.

interact.description: Use / interact with a placed block (e.g. set anchor on a knotlight, open door/chest). Context-shares Mouse2 with place: interact wins when the crosshair targets an interactive block. Onboarding token [INTERACT].

eat.description: Hold to eat/drink the selected item. Context-shares Mouse2: eat wins when the selected hotbar item is food. Onboarding token [EAT].

chat.description: Open chat. Input is ignored while typing in INPUT/TEXTAREA.

pause.description: Pause / back. Escape also fires via pointer-lock loss; editors should warn when rebinding away from Escape.

toggleFlight.description: Toggle flight (creative). Defaults to unbound on keyboard: the engine's double-tap-jump gesture covers it. Binding a key here disables neither gesture nor key.
